capacity_forecast_summary: Baseline traffic observed on Hosted: ~3.5 QPS average (off-peak 1.2 QPS), sustained peak 9 QPS during weekday daytime, short bursts up to 18 QPS for 10-20 minutes during product notifications. Avg tokens per request ~420 (prompt ~150 / completion ~270). Monthly token run-rate extrapolated from trial: ~220M tokens/month for current userbase; expected growth to 520M tokens/month in 6 months with planned feature release. Concurrency observed: typical 12; engineering requests headroom to 40 concurrent sessions for safety. Cost sensitivity: wants per-token committed pricing to reduce Hosted monthly spend estimate by ~40%.
poc_results: Performance & cost highlights from Hosted trial: p50 latency 180ms, p95 620ms on default model; streaming enabled for UX. Average tokens/day during trial 7.4M, cache hit ~12% after adding prefix caching. Estimated Hosted cost (no commitment) ~ $12k/month at observed volume; customer projects $30k/month at 6-month growth. Quality: reranker reduced search click-through time by 22% in A/B slice. SE notes recommend Dedicated for predictable SLOs and 25-45% reduction in per-token cost at committed throughput.
requirements_summary: Functional: multi-turn chat + context window ~3k tokens, document embeddings for search (512-d embeddings), reranking for top-10 results. Non-functional: p95 latency target <= 800ms for chat responses; availability 99.9% for customer-facing flows; predictable per-token unit cost. Compliance: SOC2 in place, SSO/SAML mandatory, KMS for key separation, audit logs with 90-day retention. Deployment: prefer VPC peering to start (hybrid cloud), want option to migrate to Private for EU-residency later.
dedicated_sizing_recommendation: SE workshop recommendation (summary): start with 1 dedicated pool sized for sustained 9 QPS with batching and KV cache. Suggested baseline: 4 x A10-equivalent GPUs (or 2 x A100 80GB depending on model quantization) with autoscale policy + 1 burst pool to handle 18 QPS short bursts. Caching configuration: prefix cache + 30% KV cache hit target reduces effective tokens by ~18%. Setup timeline: provision pool + VPC peering 2-3 weeks; SAML + KMS integration 1-2 weeks in parallel. Revision plan: re-evaluate after 30-day committed usage to adjust pool size.
commercial_notes: Requested committed throughput pricing table (3 tiers: 100k, 500k, 2M tokens/day) and burst allowances. MRR vs committed ARR discussion: prefer monthly ramp with quarterly true-up. Legal wants sample SLA & DPA; finance asked for 12-month commitment pricing scenarios. Forecast asks: include conservative and aggressive growth NPT (new product traffic) curves in the TCO model.
